A tall dome with four spires, the '''Monument of Duchess Geneer''' was one of the monumental structures that stood in the [[Valley of Royalty]] on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established its [[Imperial Reprogramming Institute|Reprogramming Institute]] in the vicinity of that monument.<ref name="MMY" />
